description: This file provides support for LZMA decompression in the U-Boot bootloader, implementing functions such as lzma_inflate and handling stream properties, memory allocation, and decoding process.

methods.name: int MyReadFileAndCheck(unsigned char * src,void * dest,size_t size)
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from source buffer into destination, updating read position, used internally for stream parsing.

methods.name: int lzma_inflate(unsigned char * source,int s_len,unsigned char * dest,int * d_len)
methods.description: Main function to perform LZMA decompression from source buffer to destination buffer, handling header parsing, memory management, and decoding.
